title: recordKind options are exposed but not honored
reasoning: The public option types include recordKind and loadLocalConversationSnapshot forwards a recordKind to loadStoredConversationEntries, but the local store functions hard-code CHAT_EVENT_RECORD_KIND in every IPC payload. loadStoredConversationEntries does not destructure recordKind at all. Any caller requesting a non-default record kind receives chat_event data instead, which can load, search, or list the wrong transcript records.
recommendation: Destructure recordKind with a default of CHAT_EVENT_RECORD_KIND in all affected functions and pass the normalized value through to IPC payloads. If non-chat record kinds are no longer supported, remove the option from the types and callers.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests are included for non-default recordKind propagation from snapshot loading or local store calls into IPC payloads.
suggestedRegressionTest: Inject/mock IpcBridge.invoke, call loadStoredConversationEntries/listStoredConversations/searchStoredConversations with a custom recordKind, and assert the IPC payload uses that custom value.
minimumFixScope: Fix recordKind propagation in localConversationStore and verify loadLocalConversationSnapshot's recordKind reaches GET_CHAT_EVENTS.
